blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: What makes a small trained map from encoder states to the embedding space of a frozen language model sufficient for competitive speech recognition? The premise of the SLAM-ASR architecture is that a frozen language model possesses linguistic knowledge rich enough to perform the recognition task. This assumption, while reasonable, provides little insight into the mechanisms underlying these models. We therefore seek the concrete internal structures on which they rely. This work shows that SLAM-ASR models rely on induction heads of the frozen language model: the same heads that copy repeated token sequences in text are also important for mapping speech embeddings to transcript tokens. Moreover, we find pairs of heads that behave as a constrained form of differential attention, cancelling attention noise and sharpening attention onto the previously generated word. Finally, we show how induction heads could be used to improve transcription quality under noisy audio.
blocks.zh: 是什么使得一个从编码器状态到冷冻语言模型嵌入空间的小型训练有素的地图足以进行竞争性语音识别? SLAM-ASR架构的前提是,一个冷冻的语言模型拥有足以完成识别任务的丰富语言知识. 这种假设虽然合理,但对支撑这些模型的机制却很少提供见解. 因此,我们寻求它们所依赖的具体的内部结构。 这部作品显示,SLAM-ASR模型依赖于冷冻语言模型的诱导头:在文本中复制重复的符号序列的相同的头对将语音嵌入到文本符号中也很重要. 此外,我们发现一对头像是一种受限制的差别注意形式,取消了注意的噪音,使人们更加注意以前产生的词。 最后,我们展示了如何利用上岗头来提高录音录音的录音质量。

blocks.en:
Integrating features representing the input audio with language models is at the core of automatic speech recognition (ASR) [ 14 ] . Recently, both of these constituents improved vastly, but separately, largely due to the widespread use of the Transformer architecture [ 32 ] . Speech encoder and language model fusion approaches were suggested in [ 15 , 11 , 31 ] ; see [ 30 ] for details.
An alternative method is to use a general-purpose large language model (LLM) to generate a corrected transcript for an ASR hypothesis [ 35 , 7 ] . However, the most popular method in recent years, commonly referred to as speech LLM (SLLM), is to train an LLM to also accept acoustic information from an audio encoder as input, through a learnable speech projector.
blocks.zh:
将代表输入音频的功能与语言模型融合,是自动语音识别(ASR)[14]的核心. 最近,这两个成分都有了很大的改进,但又分别,这主要是由于变形器建筑的广泛使用[32]. 建议在[15、11、31]中采用语音编码器和语言模型组合法;详情见[30]。
另一种方法是使用通用大语言模型(LLM)为ASR假说生成更正的语录[35,7]. 然而,近年来最流行的方法,通常称为语音LLM(SLLM),是训练一种LLM,也可以接受音频编码器的声学信息作为输入,通过可学习的语音投影仪.

blocks.en: Early works of this kind [ 34 , 6 , 2 ] trained the encoder and adapted the LLM through low-rank updates, together with the speech projector. SLAM-ASR [ 22 ] (Fig. 1 ), however, trains only the projector, with both encoder and LLM being frozen, yet still achieves competitive recognition. The outputs of such a projector need not coincide with token embeddings, and its sequence length differs from the text counterpart, so linguistic modelling and alignment between two sequences are to be solved by the LLM. The premise of SLAM-ASR, that the frozen LLM suffices for the linguistic task, does not name the mechanisms on which it relies, in particular, what makes the frozen decoder capable of reading the projected speech embeddings.
blocks.zh: 这种类型的早期作品[34,6,2]通过低级更新,与语音投影仪一起训练了编码器并调整了LLM. 然而,SLAM-ASR[22](图1),仅对投影仪进行训练,同时冻结编码器和LLM,但仍能实现竞争认可. 这种投影仪的输出不需要与符号嵌入重合,它的序列长度与文本对应器不同,因此语言建模和两个序列之间的对齐由LLM解决. SLAM-ASR的前提,即冷冻的LLM足以完成语言任务,没有说明它所依赖的机制,特别是是什么使得冷冻的解码器能够读取预测的语音嵌入.

blocks.en: Previous studies in internal analysis of SLLMs [ 13 ] found that in a spoken question answering context, speech and text states are similar in a broad band of middle layers. In [ 9 ] , the authors applied mechanistic interpretability tools to ASR models to analyze encoder representations and error modes such as repetition hallucination, which they linked to a single attention head in Whisper [ 29 ] . In a frozen-decoder setting like ours, many decoder layers were found redundant for ASR [ 25 ] , which suggests that recognition capability is concentrated, possibly at the head level. In this vein, text-to-speech in-context learning (ICL) work [ 28 ] considered the role of induction heads [ 5 , 26 ] , showing that, as in text, ablating them hurts ICL more than ablating random heads. In the audio LLM domain, [ 4 ] considered using text-backbone heads to steer speaker attribution. Another work [ 12 ] learned head masks to specify tasks, including ASR. For the frozen LLM decoder scenario as in SLAM-ASR, to the best of our knowledge, per-head impact on ASR has not been studied. Building upon the soft-prompting view [ 18 , 19 ] , in which the decoder is presented with a noisy and redundant version of the embedded transcript, we consider the following research questions (RQs):
blocks.zh: 先前对SLLMs内部分析的研究[13]发现,在口头回答语境中,语音和文本状态在宽幅中层类似. 在[9]中,作者将机械解释工具应用到ASR模型中,分析编码符的表示和重复幻觉等错误模式,他们在Whisper [29]中将其与单个关注头联系起来. 在像我们这样的冷冻解码器设置中,许多解码器层被发现对ASR [25]是多余的,这说明识别能力是集中的,可能是在头级. 由此可见,文本对语的内语学习(ICL)工作[28]考虑了诱导头的作用[5,26],表明和文本一样,对诱导头的擦伤比对随机头的擦伤还要多. 在音频LLM域中,[4]考虑使用文本背骨头来引导扬声器归属. 另一部作品[12]学习了戴头罩来指定任务,包括ASR. 对于SLAM-ASR中冷冻的LLM解码器情景,据我们所知,尚未研究对ASR的人均影响。 以软速感观[18,19]为基础,其中解码器呈现出一个吵闹且冗余的嵌入式记录片版本,我们考虑以下研究问题(RQs):

blocks.en: (RQ1) Does ASR quality depend on induction heads present in the frozen LLM?
blocks.zh: (RQ1) ASR的质量是否取决于冷冻LLM中存在的诱导头?

blocks.en: (RQ2) Are there heads responsible for mitigating redundancy of speech embeddings?
blocks.zh: (RQ2) 是否有负责人负责减少语音嵌入的冗余?

blocks.en: (RQ3) Does scaling induction heads at inference help recover recognition quality under noisy audio?
blocks.zh: (RQ3)在推论中缩放感应头是否有助于在吵吵的音频下恢复识别质量?

blocks.en: We show that: (1) ASR in SLAM-ASR models depends on induction heads of the frozen LLM, (2) the decoder contains pairs of heads that act together as a constrained form of differential attention [ 36 ] , sharpening attention on the speech embeddings of the previously generated word; and (3) scaling heads of (1) at inference reduces WER and insertions under noisy audio in 2 of 3 LLMs.
blocks.zh: 我们显示:(1) SLAM-ASR模型中的ASR取决于冷冻LLM的诱导头,(2) 解码器中包含对头的组合,它们共同起到受限的差分注意形式[36],使对之前生成的单词的语音嵌入的注意力更加突出;(3) 在推断中缩放(1)头,减少WER,并在3个LLMs中的2个噪声下插入.

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: This work connects SLAM-ASR speech recognition models with induction heads and differential attention. We therefore give a brief intuition behind these two notions; for a more complete picture, see [ 5 ] and [ 36 ] , respectively.
blocks.zh: 这项工作将SLAM-ASR语音识别模型与上岗头和差别关注联系起来. 因此,我们在这两个概念背后有一个简短的直觉;关于更全面的情况,分别见[5]和[36]。

blocks.en: Induction heads. On a sequence of repeated tokens … ​ A ​ B ​ … ​ A \dots A\,B\dots\allowbreak A , an induction head is an attention head that, at the second occurrence of A A , attends to the token B B that followed its first occurrence ( prefix matching ) and raises the logit of B B ( copying ), so that the model continues the sequence with B B [ 5 , 26 ] . Mechanistically, a previous-token head in an earlier layer writes the token that precedes each position into it, so the key 𝐊 {\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathbf{K}} at B B carries “preceded by A A ” information, which the query 𝐐 {\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathbf{Q}} at the second occurrence of A A matches. Such heads emerge during text pretraining of an LLM, together with ICL [ 26 ] , and can be found in a trained model via the prefix-matching score (Sec. 3 ). In our context, the speech embeddings play the role of the first occurrence (Fig. 2 ): the speech embeddings 𝒱 s j {\color[rgb]{1,0,0}\mathcal{V}_{s_{j}}} of each word approximate its generated token 𝒱 h i {\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathcal{V}_{h_{i}}} , e.g., 𝒱 s 1 , 𝒱 s 2 ≈ 𝒱 h 1 {\color[rgb]{1,0,0}\mathcal{V}_{s_{1}}},{\color[rgb]{1,0,0}\mathcal{V}_{s_{2}}}\approx{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathcal{V}_{h_{1}}} , and are followed by those of the next word. At a generated token 𝒱 h i {\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathcal{V}_{h_{i}}} , the second occurrence, an induction head therefore attends to the speech embeddings approximating 𝒱 h i + 1 {\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathcal{V}_{h_{i+1}}} , which is the pattern shown in the bottom left of Fig. 2 .

blocks.en: Differential attention. Differential attention, proposed in [ 36 ] , is an enhancement of the canonical Transformer, which mitigates attention noise, i.e., the non-negligible attention that softmax assigns to irrelevant context. Differential attention computes two softmax attention maps and subtracts the second, scaled by λ \lambda , from the first: ( softmax ⁡ ( 𝐐 1 ​ 𝐊 1 ⊤ / d ) − λ ​ softmax ​ ( 𝐐 2 ​ 𝐊 2 ⊤ / d ) ) ​ 𝐕 . \big(\mathrm{softmax}({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathbf{Q}}_{1}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathbf{K}}_{1}^{\top}/\sqrt{d})-\lambda\,\mathrm{softmax}({\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathbf{Q}}_{2}{\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathbf{K}}_{2}^{\top}/\sqrt{d})\big){\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathbf{V}}. (1) As in a differential amplifier, whose output is proportional to the difference of its two inputs, G ⁡ ( v + − v − ) G\,(v_{+}-v_{-}) , so that the signal common to both is rejected [ 36 ] , attention that both maps assign to the same positions cancels, and the resulting attention is sharper on the relevant context. In [ 36 ] , the two maps and λ \lambda are built into the architecture and trained from scratch; a pretrained LLM has no such component. In our context, attention noise can be expected to grow with the redundancy of speech embeddings: each word spans several of them, so a head reading the speech sees more keys than for the same transcript as text, each receiving some attention. Two heads of the same layer can nevertheless act together as a constrained form of differential attention (Sec. 3 ); such a pair is shown in the bottom right of Fig. 2 , where its joint attention concentrates on the speech embeddings of the previously generated word, 𝒱 h i {\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathcal{V}_{h_{i}}} .

blocks.en: 3.2 Attention noise cancelling
blocks.zh: 3.2 注意噪声取消

blocks.en: Two heads of the same layer that attend to the same speech embeddings but project what they read in opposite directions cancel part of each other’s output. If the cancelled part is the attention that both heads assign to irrelevant positions, the pair as a whole attends more sharply to the relevant ones, as differential attention does (Sec. 2 ). Below, we state how such pairs are selected, the approximation under which a pair acts as one head whose attention is the difference of the two, and how we compare its sharpness with that of h 1 h_{1} alone.
blocks.zh: 同一层的两个头, 如果取消的部分是两个头都指派给无关位置的注意,那么整对子像差分注意(sec.2 )那样更尖锐地关注相关位置. 下面,我们阐述这些对子是如何被选择的,一个对子作为一个头的近似值,它的注意力是两者的区别,我们如何将其锐度与h 1 h_{1}的锐度相比。

blocks.en: 3.3 Inference-time head scaling
blocks.zh: 3.3 推断时间头缩放

blocks.en: The performance of SLAM-ASR degrades significantly under additive noise [ 17 ] . To make use of 𝒞 k \mathcal{C}_{k} , we consider a common ASR hallucination mode under such noise: an increased insertion rate I I , the number of inserted words relative to the number of reference words. The decoder may then continue generating from its language prior; raising the output of heads that read the speech is expected to give the audio more weight against the prior. For each head ( l , h ) ∈ 𝒞 k (l,h)\in\mathcal{C}_{k} , we scale its output at every position, o t l , h ↦ α ​ o t l , h o^{l,h}_{t}\mapsto\alpha\,o^{l,h}_{t} , and compare the resulting WER and I I with those of the unscaled model, of equally many layer-matched random heads, and of all remaining heads of the same layers, each scaled by the same α \alpha .
blocks.zh: SLAM-ASR的性能在添加噪声下显著降解[17]. 要使用 Ck\ mathcal{C}_{k},我们考虑在这种噪音下常见的ASR幻觉模式:增加插入率 I,插入的单词数相对于参考单词数. 然后,解码器可能继续使用它之前的语言生成;提高读过语音的头部的输出,预期会使音频相对于前部更重. 对每个头( l, h) \\ C k( l, h)\\ mathcal{ C}_{k}, 我们按每个位置, o t l, h↦ α o t l, h}_{ mapsto\ alpha\, o^{l, h}_{t ) , 来比较产生的 WER 和 I 和 未缩放模型中的 WER 和 I , 相同多层匹配的随机头, 以及相同层的所有剩余头, 都由 α \ alpha 缩放 。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Models
blocks.zh: 4.1 模式

blocks.en: We use the instruction-tuned Llama 3.2-3B [ 10 ] , Gemma 2-2B [ 8 ] and Ministral 3-3B [ 20 ] models as decoders; for Ministral, only the text decoder is used. All three decoders use grouped-query attention [ 1 ] : the heads of a layer are split into groups, and the heads of a group share keys and values. The SLAM-ASR models use the Whisper turbo encoder [ 29 ] . The projector design follows [ 22 ] : concatenate every 5 5 consecutive encoder states and pass through a two-layer MLP with hidden size 2048 2048 and ReLU activation to the decoder’s embedding space; we append a trainable end-of-speech embedding, initialised from the decoder’s end-of-turn token. Encoder and decoder are frozen. The prompt 𝒱 p 1 , … , 𝒱 p N {\color[rgb]{0,0,1}\mathcal{V}_{p_{1}},\dots,\mathcal{V}_{p_{N}}} is “Transcribe the speech:” in each decoder’s chat template.
blocks.zh: 我们使用指示调制的Llama 3.2-3B [10],Gemma 2-2B [8] 和Ministry 3-3B [20] 模型作为解码器;对于Ministry,只使用文本解码器. 所有三个解码器都使用组-query注意[1]: 层头被拆分为组,组头共享密钥和值。 SLAM-ASR型号使用Whisper涡轮编码器[29]. 投影机设计遵循[22]:每连续5个编码器状态,并经过一个隐藏大小为2048 2048的双层MLP和ReLU激活到解码器的嵌入空间;我们附加一个可列车的词尾嵌入,从解码器的末端符号中宣布. 编码器和解码器被冻结. 提示 V p 1, ..., V p n {color[rgb]{0, 0, 1}\ mathcal{V}_{p_{1}},\dots,,\mathcal{V}_{p_{N}}}}是每个解码器聊天模板中的“输入语音 :” 。

blocks.en: 4.2 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.2 数据集

blocks.en: Each projector is trained on the train-clean-100 subset of LibriSpeech [ 27 ] and validated on 500 utterances from dev-other . Evaluation uses test-clean and test-other .
blocks.zh: 每个投影仪都接受LibriSpeech[27]的列车-清洁-100子集的训练,并用来自dev-other的500个语音进行验证. 评价采用测试清洁法和测试其他法。

blocks.en: 4.3 Training Details
blocks.zh: 4.3 培训细节

blocks.en: Optimisation follows [ 22 ] : AdamW [ 21 ] with learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} and no weight decay, 1,000 1{,}000 warm-up steps followed by a constant learning rate, and early stopping with patience 3 3 , evaluated every 500 500 steps. Unlike [ 22 ] , we use batch size 32 32 instead of 4 4 and train for at most 5 5 epochs instead of 100,000 100{,}000 steps. Each decoder is trained with three seeds.
blocks.zh: 优化后遵循[22]: 亚当W[21],学习率10−4 10^{-4}且无体重衰减,1000 1{,}000 热身步骤,随后不断学习率,早期用耐心止步 3 3,每500 步评价一次. 与[22]不同,我们使用批量尺寸32 32 而不是4 4,最多5个世纪的火车,而不是10万100{,}000步. 每个解码器用三个种子训练.

blocks.en: 4.4 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.4 评价议定书

blocks.en: Decoding is done greedily. h 1 h_{1} is selected by ASR importance on 200 dev-clean utterances. Blocking and the head pairs are evaluated on 300 test-clean utterances with Montreal Forced Aligner alignments [ 23 ] : these give the word boundaries for F t F_{t} and attention peaks. Each speech embedding covers 100 ms and is assigned to the word whose boundaries contain its centre. ASR importance, head-pair quantities and attention peaks use teacher forcing. Blocking uses k = 10 k=10 in all decoders. Scaling uses α = 1.5 \alpha=1.5 and k k equal to 3 % of the decoder’s heads (20 in Llama, 6 in Gemma, 25 in Ministral). Scaling is evaluated on 400 test-clean and 400 test-other utterances not used for blocking. We use five audio conditions: clean audio, and babble and white noise at 5 and 0 dB SNR.
blocks.zh: 解码是贪婪的 h 1 h_{1}由ASR重要性在200 dev-clean 语句上选择. 与蒙特利尔强制艾力格对齐的300个测试清洁语句对屏蔽和头对进行了评价[23]: 它们给出了F t FQQT}的字词边界和注意的峰值. 每个语音嵌入覆盖100 ms,并被分配到其边界包含其中心的单词. ASR重要性,头巾数量和注意力峰值使用教师强迫. 在所有解码器中屏蔽使用k=10k=10. 缩放使用α=1.5\alpha=1.5和kk等于解码器头的3%(Llama20、Gemma6、Ministryal25)。 对400个测试清洁语和400个测试其他不用于阻塞的语句进行放大评价。 我们使用五个音频条件: 干净的音频, 和booble和白色噪音 在5和0 dB SNR。

blocks.en: 4.5 Results
blocks.zh: 4.5 结果

blocks.en: WER under attention head blocking is reported for each decoder in Table 1 . Blocking 𝒞 10 \mathcal{C}_{10} increases WER in all three decoders. The increase is much larger in Gemma, where 10 heads are about 5 % of all heads, against 1.5 and 1.2 % in Llama and Ministral, and varies heavily between seeds. In Llama and Ministral it is milder, yet still above that of random sets of heads of the same size. Moreover, 𝒞 k \mathcal{C}_{k} makes up 40, 33 and 40 % of the 3 % of heads with the largest ASR importance in Llama, Gemma and Ministral, against 4–9 % for random heads of the same layers. Within the speech embeddings, the attention of 𝒞 k \mathcal{C}_{k} peaks on the word being generated for 64–76,% of tokens, against 45–56,% for equally many heads with the largest attention mass on S S . These results show that ASR in SLAM-ASR models is concentrated in induction heads of the frozen decoder.
blocks.zh: 表1中每个解码器都报告注意头封堵下的WER。 屏蔽 C 10\ mathcal{C}_{10} 在全部三个解码器中增加WER. Gemma的增幅更大,10个头约占所有头的5%,而Llama和Ministry的比重分别为1.5%和1.2%,种子之间差异很大。 在Llama和Ministry,它比较温和,但仍高于大小相同的随机头部。 此外,Ck \ mathcal{C}_{k}占Llama、Gemma和Ministry中具有最大ASR重要性的3%头的40、33和40%,而同一层随机头的4-9%。 Ck \ mathcal{C}_{k}的注意力在64-76个符号上达到顶点, 这些结果显示,SLAM-ASR模型中的ASR集中在冷冻解码器的诱导头.

blocks.en: Head pairs that meet the conditions of an attention noise cancelling pair are reported for each decoder in Table 2 . In all three decoders, the h 2 h_{2} output for each speech embedding is approximately a negative multiple of the h 1 h_{1} output, as the − cos -\cos column shows, indicating that the two heads act as one head with differential attention [ 36 ] . The effective attention of the pairs also supports this view: as the eff. column shows, it is sharper on the speech embeddings of the previously generated word than the attention of h 1 h_{1} alone in all decoders, though only slightly in Ministral. Blocking h 1 h_{1} alone increases WER far more than blocking both heads, whereas blocking h 2 h_{2} alone leaves it unchanged in Gemma and Ministral: the two heads act as a unit, and blocking one leaves the output of the other uncancelled. Blocked together, the pair costs little in Llama and Ministral and more in Gemma; its sharper attention describes how the pair reads the speech rather than how much recognition depends on it.
blocks.zh: 表2中报告每个解码器符合注意噪声取消条件的头对对对。 在所有三个解码器中,每个语音嵌入的h 2 h_{2}输出大约是h 1 h_{1}输出的负倍数,如 − cos -\cos 栏所示,表示两个头作为一个头,有差别的注意 [36]. 双方的有效关注也支持这一观点:作为eff. 列显示,它比所有解码器中h 1 h\\\1}的注意力更尖锐,尽管在Ministryal中略微。 仅屏蔽h 1 h_{1}会增加WER 远远不止于屏蔽两个头,而屏蔽h 2 h_{2}在Gemma和Mindernal中则会保持不变:两个头作为单元,屏蔽一个则会留下另一个未屏蔽的输出. 组合在一起,在Llama和Ministryal以及Gemma的组合成本都很小;它的更尖锐的注意描述了组合如何阅读演讲,而不是多多的认可依赖于它.

blocks.en: WER and insertion rate I I under scaling are reported for each decoder in Table 3 . Under noisy audio, scaling 𝒞 k \mathcal{C}_{k} results in lower WER and I I than scaling the same number of random heads (by 1.4–2.6 WER in the noisy mean) or the remaining heads of the same layers (by 4.6–10.9) in all three decoders, which indicates that the reduction is not an effect of scaling heads in these layers as such. Scaling instead equally many heads with the largest ASR importance reduces WER less than scaling 𝒞 k \mathcal{C}_{k} in Llama (by 2.4, noisy mean), about as much in Ministral, and more in Gemma (by 4.5). Compared to the unscaled model, scaling 𝒞 k \mathcal{C}_{k} reduces WER and I I in Llama and Ministral almost only under babble noise at 0 dB, where insertions are most frequent; under the other noisy conditions WER changes by less than 1 point. In Gemma, scaling heads of these layers increases WER, and scaling 𝒞 k \mathcal{C}_{k} increases it least. On clean audio, scaling 𝒞 k \mathcal{C}_{k} increases WER by at most 0.2 points.

blocks.en: 4.6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.6 讨论情况

blocks.en: The link between SLAM-ASR models and induction heads of the frozen LLM gives a concrete answer to the question we posed in Sec. 1 : it suggests that a small map suffices because its outputs only need to be readable by the LLM’s existing context-reading circuits, which perform prefix matching on them. This raises the empirical question of how projector training should be done, especially when done jointly with the decoder. For instance, updating only the heads with the highest PM \mathrm{PM} score, rather than the whole decoder, is a potentially promising approach.
blocks.zh: SLAM-ASR模型与冷冻LLM的诱导头之间的联系为我们在Sec.1中提出的问题提供了具体答案:它暗示一个小地图就足够了,因为它的输出只需要LLM现有的上下文读取电路可以读取,这些电路在它们上进行前缀匹配. 这就提出了如何进行投影仪培训的经验性问题,特别是在与解码器联合进行时。 例如,仅更新PM\mathrm{PM}得分最高的头,而不是整个解码器,是可能很有希望的办法。

blocks.en: The attention noise cancelling pairs we found show that text-pretrained LLMs contain heads that act together to cancel attention noise on redundant input, without being explicitly trained for it, while [ 16 ] has to add differential attention to a pretrained LLM through adaptation. Heads that read the same input and project in opposite directions are known in text LLMs as negative and copy-suppression heads [ 33 , 24 ] , which act on the logits of copied tokens; the pairs we found share keys and values, and their subtraction acts on attention. It is not clear how these heads emerge during text pretraining, which is a promising direction for mechanistic interpretability research.
blocks.zh: 我们发现的注意噪声取消对子显示,文字预训LLMs包含头部,它们一起作用,在冗余输入上取消注意噪声,而没有为此进行明确的训练,而[16]则必须通过适应对预训LLM增加差别的注意. 在文本 LLMs 中,读取相同输入和工程方向相反的头被称作负数和复制压制头 [33, 24] , 其作用是复制的令牌的对数; 我们发现的对数是共享的键和值, 以及它们在注意力上的减值行为. 不清楚这些头是如何在文字预训期间出现的,这是机械解释性研究的一个很有希望的方向.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we have shown that speech recognition with LLMs in models such as SLAM-ASR depends on induction heads of the frozen LLM. In the decoders we considered, pairs of attention heads act together as a constrained form of differential attention, cancelling attention noise and sharpening attention on the speech embeddings of the previously generated word. Induction heads also matter when doing recognition on noisy audio: scaling them at inference mitigates hallucinations in two of the three decoders we consider.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们已经表明,在SAM-ASR等模型中,对LLMs的语音识别取决于冷冻LLM的感应头. 在我们所考虑的解码器中,双倍的注意力头一起作为受限制的差别注意力形式作用,取消了注意力噪声,并增强了对之前生成的词的语音嵌入的注意. 入门头像在对响亮的音频进行识别时也很重要:在推断时将其缩放,可以减轻我们考虑的三个解码器中的两个的幻觉.
